The '''Mila system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mila (planet)|Mila]]. It was named after the [[Aramandi]]'s [[Mila (akia)|Mila]].
